xs.description: Colour and opacity changes on hover/focus. Most common duration in shield-kendo-styles and the four-stack wrappers.

sm.description: Fades and small reveals. Most common duration in the shipped demo application.

lg.description: Expand and collapse. Kendo ExpansionPanel default; Accordion spec §3.

xl.description: Emphasis and long reveals. Use sparingly.

linear.description: Constant rate. Progress and determinate indicators only.

ease.description: CSS default curve. Most common easing in shipped styles.

ease-out.description: Fast start, soft landing. Identical to CSS ease-out; written out because shipped stylesheets use the explicit form.
